businessGoal: Allow users to filter products by brand to improve product discoverability.

scenarios.goal: Verify that brand checkboxes are displayed correctly in the sidebar.
Verify that selecting one or more brand checkboxes updates the product grid to show only products from the selected brands.
Verify that selecting both categories and brand checkboxes updates the product grid to show only products matching both filters.

manual.reason: The story involves user interactions with checkboxes and visible updates in the product grid.

api.reason: The behavior of product filtering can likely be validated through API calls behind the filtering functionality.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe browser behavior, visible elements, and user interactions.
